articleTitle: Non-Reference Image Quality Assessment Based on Super-Pixel Segmentation and Information Entropy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Because the existing Blind/Non-reference Image Spatial Quality Evaluator (BRISQUE) algorithm does not take the factor of image information into consideration when evaluating image quality. Therefore, in order to improve the stability and accuracy of the BRISQUE algorithm, a superpixel segmentation blind/non-reference image spatial quality evaluator (S-BRISQUE) based on the information entropy weighting of superpixel segmentation is proposed. First, the image is segmented according to the similarity of the image information, and the information entropy matrix of each part of the sub-image is calculated after the segmentation. Then, the entropy matrix is used to weight the average subtractive contrast normalization (MSCN) parameter matrix, and the MSCN parameter based on the image information is used as the weight. The proposed S-BRISQUE algorithm was verified on the Live benchmark database. Compared with the BRISQUE algorithm and other classic algorithms, the S-BRISQUE algorithm has a higher prediction accuracy rate, also better than some evaluation algorithms.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Dual Band Microstrip Antenna for WLAN
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: WLAN is an important interconnection environment for home and industry. In this paper, I will introduce a dual-band antenna we design. The antenna is printed on the Rogers RT5880 substrate with a thickness of 1.8 mm and the size of it is 30*24 mm. This paper uses a 50-ohm feeder to feed the antenna. The high-frequency simulation software HFSS is used to model and analyze the antenna. The defected ground and stepped structures are used to expand the bandwidth. The method of etching the gap is used to trap the wave. The antenna meets the requirements of IEEE802.11 (2.4G-2.48GHz and 5.15G-5.85GHz). The working frequency band's S11 is less than −10dB with enough bandwidth.

articleTitle: Workpiece Intelligent Identification and Positioning System based on Binocular Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: In this paper, a workpiece detection and positioning system has been studied. Firstly, data sets of workpieces with three different shapes (cube, cylinder and sphere) are established, and the YOLOV3 target detection algorithm is used for deep learning to realize intelligent recognition of different shapes of workpieces. Then by the use of binocular machine vision technology, the key points position of workpieces can be successfully detected with relative error less than 2 %. This workpiece detection and positioning system can be introduced in the mechanical arm grabbing control system to make it have the visual ability similar to human in order to realize mechanical arm intelligent grabbing in complex environment.

articleTitle: A Novel Face Forgery Detection Method Based on Edge Details and Reused-Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: In recent years, with the widespread popularity of digital media editing software and rapid development of deep learning techniques, the technology barriers for generating fake faces becomes lower and lower. As a result, forged face images have become more and more realistic, and a large number of high-quality fake face images are created and spread in our day lives. Therefore, determining the authenticity of face images is a challenging task and major focus of multimedia security research. To solve this problem, a novel face forgery detection method based on edge details and Reused-Network (RN) is proposed. Specifically, based on Sobel and Laplacian operators, we consider the differences in edge details between real and fake faces, and further learn these differences through RN to eventually extract more detailed features. The derived features are then used to train a Support Vector Machine (SVM) classifier for classification. The proposed method has a good performance on detecting fake face images, and it is experimentally verified better than some state-of-the-art works.

articleTitle: Optimized Dynamic Load Balance Method Based on Ant Colony Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Oriented to dynamic load balance of high concurrent cluster, an Optimized Dynamic Load Balance Method (ODLBM) based on Ant Colony Optimization (ACO) is proposed in this paper. Compared to traditional static load balance approach, ODLBM tends to resolve complex dynamic load balance problem with dynamic cluster and heterogeneous tasks. First, the dynamic load balance problem is transformed to the optimization problem based on ACO. After that, the optimized calculation of distance via comprehensive indicator of weights, and the optimized update of pheromone are introduced into the ACO model to improve the performance of basic ACO model in complex dynamic load balance scenario. Finally, the efficiency of ODLBM is validated by the experiment based on JMeter simulation, compared to the classical Weighted Round Robin (WRR) method, and Fastest Response Time (FRT) method.

articleTitle: Detection Algorithm of Local Outlier Based on Variable Dense Cell
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low detection rate and poor time performance in the detection of abnormal points in the LOF algorithm, an improved algorithm for local outlier detection of variable dense cell is proposed. The algorithm has been improved in two aspects. One is the dynamic meshing of variable density cells, which can merge adjacent grids with similar data into a large grid, reducing the number of grids. The other is to quickly set some key parameters of dynamic mesh generation. The experimental results show that compared with the outlier detection algorithms in the literature, the improved algorithm has a certain degree of improvement in meshing effect, time performance and detection rate.

articleTitle: An Improved Quantum Ant Colony Algorithm for Fuzzy Dynamic Vehicle Routing Problem
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: For dynamic vehicle path problems with stochastic demand, a two-stage model is used with the objective of minimizing cost and maximizing customer satisfaction in this paper. The dynamic vehicle routing problem is converted into a static vehicle routing problem, and the quantum theory is combined with the ant colony algorithm. Quantum <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$H_{\mathcal{E}}$</tex> Gate is used to update the ant colony instead of the traditional quantum revolving gate. Using MATLAB simulation data, the quantum ant colony algorithm improved in this paper is confirmed to be one of the efficient methods to solve the problem.

articleTitle: Appearance Detection of HPLC Communication Module Based on Res-DU-Net
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: For the purpose of solving the problem of appearance detection of HPLC communication module, firstly, the pixel-level scratch detection is realized through convolution, residual structure, dilated convolution, cascade and other operations, forming a U-shaped model structure —Res-DU-Net. Secondly, Adam algorithm is adopted to train and verify the appearance image of HPLC communication module. Finally, Res-DU-Net achieves an accuracy rate of 0.985 and a recall rate of 0.987 when the learning rate is 0.001 and the loss rate is 0.020. The experimental results show that Res-DU-Net has more advantages than traditional methods and FCN in pixel-level scratch detection.

articleTitle: G-DAN-SNR: An improved Personalized POI recommendation algorithm based on gating and attention mechanism
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: In the field of POI recommendation, some scholars proposed the DAN-SNR model, which constructs the deep learning network by self-attention mechanism and designs dual channels to capture users' long and short interest preferences and social influence. Based on the improvement of the DAN-SNR model, the gating mechanism is introduced in this paper based on the self-attentive mechanism before its long- and short-term interest preference features are fused, and the optimal features are filtered by weighting the feature parameters.

articleTitle: Research on Matrix Description of Electromagnetic Interference Between Cables
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: This paper studies the description of the electromagnetic interference matrix between the cable harnesses when it has multiple interference sources, and gives the definition of the electromagnetic interference matrix of multiple interference sources and the calculation method of interference coefficients. Combined with the simulation and calculation of the multiple interference source model, the cable bundle B and the cable bundle C are calculated separately. The near and far-end crosstalk of the disturbed cable A when acting and simultaneously acting, the degree of influence of multiple interference sources and single interference sources on the disturbed unit is obtained by analysis. The corresponding electromagnetic interference matrix is given to verify the application effect of the proposed technical method.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Improved Probabilistic Neural Network Algorithm in Dynamics of Flexible Job-shop under the Situation of Arrival of New Workpiece
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: In this paper, an improved probabilistic neural network algorithm is designed for the problems such as failure to respond quickly to interference, resulted long waiting time and the extension of idle time of the machine existing in the dynamic dispatch of flexible job-shop under the situation of arrival of new workpiece. The algorithm uses the main component analysis method to reduce the dimension of high-dimensional feature data, adopts the improved sparrow algorithm to optimize the smoothing factor, and completes the training and prediction of the model based on the simulation sample. Improved model can reduce the effect of noise and data redundancy in the sample, and improve the self-adaptiveness and certain immunity to disturbance. The experimental results show that the algorithm has significantly improved the classification ability of job-shop scheduling under the interference of the arrival of new workpieces.

articleTitle: Research on SCARA Robot Fault Diagnosis Based on Hilbert-Huang Transform and Decision Tree
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Aiming at the current situation that industrial equipment failures are difficult to detect and diagnose with low efficiency, this paper takes Selective Compliance Assembly Robot Arm (SCARA) robots as the research object and proposes a method for extracting SCARA robot features based on Hilbert-Huang Transform (HHT). First, the original vibration signal is separated by the empirical mode decomposition (EMD) algorithm, and the intrinsic mode function (IMF) is obtained. Then the envelope of IMF is obtained through Hilbert transform and the spectrum energy of each envelope is calculated. Finally, the representative envelope spectrum energy is selected and combined into the feature vector of the signal, and the decision tree (DT) is used for classification prediction. The conclusion shows that the method proposed in this paper can accurately and effectively identify the state of SCARA robots and can be better applied to fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Multi-Exposure Fusion with Adaptive Well-Exposedness Weight Factor and Enhanced Guided Filtering
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: A multi-exposure fusion method is presented to optimize weight factor of well-exposure and the global weight map for multi-scale image fusion. In the method, the weight factors of local contrast weight factors, well-exposedness and color inconsistency are considered to estimate initial global weight map, where the well-exposure weight factor is adaptively adjusted for the intensity of the exposure, and the details of the over-exposure and under-exposure are perfectly preserved. Additionally, the enhanced guided filtering with adaptive adjustment of regularization parameters according to the gradient of the image is employed to de-noise and maintain continuity. Experiment results demonstrate that the weight detail optimization method achieves a certain gain for existing multi-scale and multi-exposure image fusions, which provides a feasible optimization scheme for multi-exposure fusions for consumer-level cameras.

articleTitle: The Applied Research of Improved Genetic Algorithm in Data Automatic Generation of Software Test
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Software test is the inevitable process of software develop, while the automatic generation of test data can save time and resource cost in the stage of software test. In order to improve the efficiency of test automation, this paper would like to improve the basic genetic algorithm and then apply it to the automatic generation mode of software test data. In the improved genetic algorithm, the reasonable fitness function is designed, the selection operator is operated by tournament selection method and introduce simulated annealing mechanism to improve adaptive crossover operator and mutation operator. Through the comparison between basic genetic algorithm and improved genetic algorithm, the performance analysis is conducted. The experiment shows the high efficiency of new algorithm in automatic generation process of test cases.

articleTitle: Green Development Level Evaluation of Urban Agglomeration Based on Improved Cloud Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Urban agglomeration is the product of the economic and urban development of a country at a given time. In this study, an index system for evaluating the green development level of the SC region was initially constructed based on four dimensions. Then, using the cloud model theory, we scored the green development level of the SC region, Yangtze River Delta, and BTH region and generated a cloud model image.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation Method of Cables Conduction Interference Pulse Waveform
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Aiming at the simulation problem of conducted interference between cables in the narrow space of ships, a method of conducting interference pulse modeling and simulation based on time-domain finite integration method and related operation procedures are proposed. First, according to the crosstalk mechanism, the transmission line model is established in the scenario, Second, the transmission line equation is established and the proximal interference voltage is solved. Finally, the CST simulation tool is used to perform numerical calculations on the above-mentioned model scenarios, and the results of theoretical model calculations and simulation numerical calculations are compared to verify the effectiveness of the proposed simulation method.

articleTitle: Graph Data Augmentation based on Adaptive Graph Convolution for Skeleton-based Action Recognition
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Recently, action recognition based on graph data has received widespread attention. Graph convolutional neural networks need a large amount of graph data support. Therefore, graph data augmentation has significant research value. Existing graph data augmentation methods are generally based on graph structure or graph node features to add or remove graph edges, leading to problems in generality and effectiveness. To improve the above issues, this paper utilizes adaptive graph convolution to design an algorithm that obtains the optimal graph connection for graph data augmentation as graph convolution proceeds, which greatly improves the generalization and effectiveness. The results on NTU-RGBD and Kinetics-Skeleton datasets for skeleton-based action recognition prove that our proposed method reveals better results than existing methods.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on Employment Competence of Engineering Students Based on Structural Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Based on the statistical software SPSS 18.0 and structural equation software Liserel 8.5, this paper conducted the analysis of exploratory and confirmatory factors on engineering students' employment competence. The author tried to construct a four-dimensional model consisting of career development, personality traits, general skills and interpersonal skills, providing guidance for college students to draw up a reasonable career planning, and a scientific basis for colleges and universities to perfect the talent training system.

articleTitle: Design of Satellite Communication Channel Monitoring Sequence Length
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: In satellite communication system, the quality of channel affects the communication performance of system directly. According to the characteristics of satellite communication, the length of satellite communication channel monitoring sequence is designed. The design of the length can not only meet requirement of the satellite communication channel quality monitoring, but also the need of capture probability and capture time of the receiver to the monitoring sequence, which avoids the influence of low capture or long delay on the channel real-time monitoring. In order to solve the poor quality of satellite communication channel, we design the length of the monitoring sequence in the case of high error, and the error analysis of CSI (channel state information) is carried out and capture probability and capture time of monitoring sequence is analyzed in this paper. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Source Data Fusion Method under the Background of Unified Real Estate Registration
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: In-depth analysis and discussion of the integration methods in the implementation of the unified registration of real estate can better provide effective data protection for the real estate management department. Taking the land data and real estate data involved in real estate registration as an example, this paper discusses the process and method of standardized integration by analyzing the problems existing in data integration, and realizes the standardization and unification of multi-source data integration through the integration of land data and real estate data. At the same time, the data batch processing model constructed based on the Model-Builder provided by ArcGIS realizes the batch automatic processing of real estate data integration, improves the efficiency of data integration and storage, and lays a solid foundation for the unified registration data integration and storage of real estate.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Rolling Bearing Based on BP Nural Network Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: This paper uses the experimental bearing fault platform to collect the normal bearing vibration acceleration signal by bvt-8 vibrator, resulting in the inner ring peeling and the outer ring peeling. After the average signal zero processing, the rolling vibration signal is analyzed by decomposition wave pack, and the energy moment of the decomposition wave packet is normalized into a characteristic vector: Firstly, the extracted data are processed as samples, and the training set and test set are randomly divided. Then, BP Neural Network is used for training and testing to obtain data, and the training and test results are compared with those of CNN neural network. The effectiveness of this method in the fault diagnosis of deep groove ball bearings is verified.

articleTitle: Research on Simulation and Test Verification of Cable Conducted Interference Based on FDTD
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Rectifier bridges and inverter bridge systems in high-power power equipment are usually sources of conduction interference on sensitive equipment. In order to effectively estimate the interference signal from the cable coupling to the sensitive equipment, based on the multiconductor transmission line theory, a cable transmission line model that can reflect the distribution parameters between the lines is established, and the finite difference time domain method and the discrete multi-conductor transmission line cable equation are studied to solve the iterative equations of the beginning and the end are used to obtain the interference value at the sensitive equipment. Finally, the correctness of the method is proved by experimental simulation.

articleTitle: Research on DDoS Attack Detection based on Multi-dimensional Entropy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: DDoS attack detection in a single dimension cannot cope with complex and new attacks. Aiming at the problems existing in single dimension detection, this paper proposes an algorithm to detect DDoS attack based on multi-dimensional entropy. Firstly, the algorithm selects multiple dimensions and establishes corresponding decision function for each dimension and calculates its information entropy. Secondly, the multidimensional sliding window CUSUM algorithm without parameters is used to synthesize the detection results of three dimensions to determine whether it is attacked by DDoS. Finally, the data set published by MIT Lincoln Laboratory is used for testing. Experimental results show that compared with single dimension detection algorithm, this method has good detection rate and low false alarm rate.

articleTitle: A PQBM-Based Mobile Crowdsensing Caching Strategy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Mobile crowdsensing typically uses multiple copies for data forwarding. Meanwhile, the limited cache of nodes, and the overlapping sensing range between nodes, often leads to network congestion situation. Therefore, it is still a key issue to establish a reasonable and effective cache management strategy in mobile crowdsensing. In this work, we propose a priority queue-based cache management method (PQBM). With the objective to optimal cache management, the PQBM first divides nodes cache into source message queues and relay message queues, then performs different message discard policies according to the prioritization mechanism of queues when congestion occurs in the network. The simulation results highlight the strength of the PQBM strategy as it can guarantee message discard fairness and cache dynamic balance, verify that PQBM strategy can significantly reduce the network overhead, latency, packet loss rate and achieve better performance than other existing schemes.

articleTitle: Research on Simulation of Multi-Electromagnetic Interference Sources on Cables
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: With the rapid development of modern information technology, the influence of cables interference on electromagnetic compatibility has become increasingly prominent. Therefore, the conduction interference of cable under the action of multiple interference sources has been extensively discussed and studied. This paper starts from the electromagnetic interference simulation technological process of the cable with multi-interference sources, demonstrates and proposes the interference analysis process of the dual-conductor transmission line and the multi-conductor transmission cable, explains the main work content of each step in the process, and gives an implementation case to prove the rationality of the process.

articleTitle: Research on Evaluation of Green Development Level of Urban Agglomeration Based on Interval Optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: With the development of urban economy reaching a certain scale, restricted by resources, population, politics, industrial development and other aspects, urban agglomeration is an important form to promote the optimization of urban development. Green development is one of the important development concepts insisted by China. It is of great significance to rationally evaluate the green development of urban agglomerations. Therefore, this paper carries out evaluation research on the green development level of urban agglomerations. By sorting out the main influencing factors in the green development of urban agglomerations, the evaluation indicator system for the green development level of urban agglomerations is constructed. Combined with the evaluation optimization model, the optimization is mainly carried out from three aspects: indicator assignment, indicator weight and comprehensive evaluation model. In Yangtze River delta urban agglomeration, Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei urban agglomeration, and Chengdu-Chongqing urban agglomeration as the research object, the urban green development level evaluation has been studied. And the result shows that the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei urban agglomeration in urban green development evaluation result is the best. At the same time, the indicators are validated by sensitivity analysis of the influence degree of the evaluation results.

articleTitle: Scalable Distributed Organizational Structure and Self-Organization Mechanisms for Unmanned System Cluster
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Reasonable control organizational structure can help an unmanned system cluster cooperate more effectively to complete tasks. Previous research of existing organizational structures has problems implementing the task in a natural environment, such as the cluster's lack of scalability. This paper proposes a three-layer scalable distributed organizational structure and dynamic self-organization mechanisms, which overcomes the lack of scalability and ensures that the cluster can still perform stably after the cluster size changes. The simulation results show that the organizational structure realizes information sharing and cross-layer control, which enhance the flexibility and stability of unmanned system clusters. Comparison results show that our achievements can make a good performance, contributing to this area of future research.

articleTitle: Hybrid Attention Mechanism Guided Convolutional Neural Network for Breast Cancer Histology Images Classification
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Objective: Breast cancer is the most vulnerable type of cancer for women, examination of histopathological sections is the gold standard for diagnosing cancer. However, the high complexity and the increasing number of pathological images make the work of pathological diagnosis extremely time-consuming, and the sharp increase in the workload of pathologists will also cause the diagnosis results to be subjectively affected. Therefore, the development of an automated and accurate method for histopathological images analysis is critical to assist pathologists in their work. Methods: In this paper, we propose a deep learning method guided by the hybrid attention mechanism for fast and effective classification on the hematoxylin & eosin stained breast biopsy images. Firstly, this method takes advantages of DenseNet and utilizes the information of the feature map. Afterward, attention and channel attention are used to guide the extraction of the most useful visual features. Results: With the use of five-fold cross-validation, the best model obtaines an accuracy of 96.10% on the BACH2018 dataset. We also evaluate our method on other datasets, and the experimental results demonstrate that our model has reliable performance. Conclusions: This study indicates that our histopathological image classifier with a hybrid domain attention-guided deep-learning model for breast cancer shows significantly better results than the latest methods. It has great potential as an effective tool for automatic evaluation of digital histopathological microscopic images for computer-aided diagnosis.
